arxiv-2111-01316.title: Floquet engineering of Kitaev quantum magnets
arxiv-2111-01316.creator: Umesh Kumar, Saikat Banerjee, Shi-Zeng Lin
arxiv-2111-01316.description: Abstract In recent years, there has been an intense search for materials realizing the Kitaev quantum spin liquid model. A number of edge-shared compounds with strong spin-orbit coupling, such as RuCl 3 and iridates, have been proposed to realize this model.

arxiv-2205-07970.title: SciLander: Mapping the Scientific News Landscape
arxiv-2205-07970.creator: Maurício Gruppi, Panayiotis Smeros, Sibel Adalı Carlos Castillo Karl Aberer
arxiv-2205-07970.description: Abstract The COVID-19 pandemic has fueled the spread of misinformation on social media and the Web as a whole. The phenomenon dubbed ‘infodemic’ has taken the challenges of information veracity and trust to new heights by massively introducing seemingly scientific and technical elements into misleading content.

arxiv-2211-10766.title: Sociality and Skill Sharing in the Garden DOI: https://doi.org/10.1145/3313831.3376246 Conference: CHI’20, April 25–30, 2020, Honolulu, HI, USA
arxiv-2211-10766.creator: Hanuma Teja Maddali Amanda Lazar
arxiv-2211-10766.description: Abstract Gardening is an activity that involves a number of dimensions of increasing interest to HCI and CSCW researchers, including recreation, sustainability, and engagement with nature. This paper considers the garden setting in order to understand the role that collaborative and social computing technologies might play for practitioners engaging in outdoor skilled activities.

Central to this endeavor is the precise extraction of product attributes from customer queries, enabling refined search, comparison, and other crucial e-commerce functionalities.

arxiv-2408-13352.title: QAdaPrune: Adaptive Parameter Pruning For Training Variational Quantum Circuits
arxiv-2408-13352.creator: Ankit Kulshrestha, Xiaoyuan Liu, Hayato Ushijima-Mwesigwa, Bao Bach, Ilya Safro
arxiv-2408-13352.description: Abstract In the present noisy intermediate scale quantum computing era, there is a critical need to devise methods for the efficient implementation of gate-based variational quantum circuits. This ensures that a range of proposed applications can be deployed on real quantum hardware.

arxiv-2411-14610.title: The origin of strings and rings in the atomic dynamics of disordered systems
arxiv-2411-14610.creator: Omar Hussein, Yang Li, Yuri Mishin
arxiv-2411-14610.description: Abstract It has long been believed that the atomic dynamics in disordered structures, such as undercooled liquids and pre-melted interfaces, are characterized by collective atomic rearrangements in the form of quasi-one-dimensional chains of atomic displacements (strings) and their closed forms (rings).

arxiv-2505-21173.title: Topological Deep Learning for Speech Data
arxiv-2505-21173.creator: Zhiwang Yu
arxiv-2505-21173.description: Abstract . Topological data analysis (TDA) offers novel mathematical tools for deep learning. Inspired by Carlsson et al., this study designs topology-aware convolutional kernels that significantly improve speech recognition networks. Theoretically, by investigating orthogonal group actions on kernels, we establish a fiber-bundle decomposition of matrix spaces, enabling new filter generation methods.

europmc-pmc6254722.description: Pentavalent antimonials, including meglumine antimoniate and sodium stibogluconate, have been used for more than half a century in the therapy of the parasitic disease leishmaniasis. Even though antimonials are still the first-line drugs, they exhibit several limitations,...

pmc-10570972.title: The challenging patient in autologous breast reconstruction: obesity, breast ptosis and beyond
pmc-10570972.creator: Edward H Nahabet, Christopher A Crisera
pmc-10570972.description: Autologous breast reconstruction has consistently demonstrated excellent patient satisfaction, ideal aesthetic results, and a low risk of complications. With the increasing incidence of breast cancer diagnoses and higher reconstruction rates, surgeons encounter a broader spectrum of patients. Obese patients undergoing breast reconstruction are more likely to experience a surgical complication.

pmc-11342817.title: Improving anti-oxidant stress treatment of subarachnoid hemorrhage through self-assembled nanoparticles of oleanolic acid
pmc-11342817.creator: Youdong Zhou, Hengyu Wang, Xinyi Zhu, Qingyu Zhao, Gang Deng, Yong Li, Qianxue Chen
pmc-11342817.description: Subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) is a life-threatening acute hemorrhagic cerebrovascular disease, with early brain injury (EBI) being the main cause of high mortality and severe neurological dysfunction. Oxidative stress plays a crucial role in the pathogenesis of EBI. In this study, we synthesized antioxidant stress nanoparticles based on self-assembled oleanolic acid (OA) using the solvent volatilization method.

pmc-11474174.title: Prescribers' perspectives: The impact of the controlled substance scheduling system on providing optimal patient care
pmc-11474174.creator: Michael R Barnes, Yijia Luo, Jonathon M Parker, Brian M Shepler
pmc-11474174.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundIn the United States, the scheduling system for controlled substances was established by the Controlled Substance Act of 1970. In 2009, Parker et al. published the study “Physicians' knowledge and attitudes toward scheduling.” Since 2009, the opioid epidemic has gathered national attention from social and scientific perspectives as the number of drug overdose deaths in the United States has nearly tripled.ObjectiveTo follow up on a 2009 survey by Parker, et al.

pmc-11633278.title: Effectiveness of Osteoarthritis Management Program (OAMP) on the Level of Knowledge and Practice Regarding Self-Management Among Elderly with Osteoarthritis
pmc-11633278.creator: Pratima Sapkota, Venkatesan Balu, Sonia Kamei, Yumnam Sushma Devi
pmc-11633278.description: Objectives:To assess the effectiveness of osteoarthritis management program (OAMP) on the level of knowledge and practice regarding self-management among elderly with OA.Materials and Methods:A quasi-experimental study was conducted among 60 elderly with osteoarthritis (OA) from March 1, 2021, to March 29, 2021.

pmc-12431466.title: Monitoring of Ammonia in Biomass Combustion Flue Gas Using a Zeolite-Based Capacitive Sensor
pmc-12431466.creator: Thomas Wöhrl, Mario König, Ralf Moos, Gunter Hagen
pmc-12431466.description: The emissions from biomass combustion systems have recently been the subject of increased attention. In addition to elevated concentrations of particulate matter and hydrocarbons (HCs) in the flue gas, significant levels of NOx emissions occur depending on the used fuel, such as biogenic residues.

pmc-12436500.title: An injectable curcumin-loaded hydrogel for neuroprotective treatment promote nerve tissue repair in rat severe spinal cord injury
pmc-12436500.creator: Zhaoqing Zhang, Haiyan Ma, Ruisong Tian, Guangwei Li, Fuchang Zhao, Liangyu Xie, Hao Chen
pmc-12436500.description: IntroductionSpinal Cord Injury (SCI) leads to severe motor and sensory impairments and underscores the urgent need for the development of effective treatment approaches. The injury microenvironment with oxidation, inflammation and extracellular matrix disruption represents a major barrier to nerve tissue repair as well as the functioning of therapeutic factors.

pmc-12734811.title: Composite Structure as a Stress Wave Barrier Zone Under Impulse Loading: Microscale Numerical Analysis of Attenuation
pmc-12734811.creator: Zuzana Murčinková, Dominik Sabol, Petr Baron
pmc-12734811.description: Highlights What are the main findings? In discontinuously reinforced composites, hollow inclusions enhance stress wave attenuation by over 20% compared to solid ones due to greater deformation and scattering.Elongated inclusion orientation strongly affects attenuation, with perpendicular alignment increasing efficiency by 18.5%.A compliant interlayer and specified inclusion distribution further improve attenuation by 3–11%. What is the implication of the main finding?

pmc-12736949.title: IoT Authentication in Federated Learning: Methods, Challenges, and Future Directions
pmc-12736949.creator: Arwa Badhib, Suhair Alshehri, Asma Cherif, Ilsun You
pmc-12736949.description: The Internet of Things (IoT) has established an exceptional ecosystem of interconnected devices where a vast multitude of heterogeneous devices can communicate, collect, and share data for enhanced decision-making processes. To effectively analyze this immense volume of data, researchers have deployed advanced machine learning algorithms and deep neural networks.

pmc-13053540.title: Residence and insurance inequities in the timeliness of access to first-eye cataract surgery in Eastern China
pmc-13053540.creator: Chen Qin, Jie Zhu, Tian Yang
pmc-13053540.description: PurposeTo quantify residence and insurance inequities in the timeliness of access to first-eye cataract surgery in Eastern China, using better-eye best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) at surgical-pathway entry as an electronic health record–derived indicator.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective cohort study of consecutive first-eye cataract surgeries at a tertiary hospital in Yangzhou, China (August 2024–July 2025).

pmc-13086946.title: Junction opener enables CAR T cell treatment of solid tumors
pmc-13086946.creator: Steven J Reed, Shibbu Sharma, Carrie Novák, Jiho Kim, Kaman Kim, Erene Niemi, Nicholas Korjeff, André Lieber, Steven G Reed, Malcolm S Duthie, Darrick Carter
pmc-13086946.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Physical barriers presented by solid tumors limit CAR T cell efficacy. Thus, technologies to increase CAR T cell access to solid tumors could have massive implications in advancing CAR T cell therapies.

pmc-13231072.title: Differential Expression Analysis of Key Inflammatory Mediators in Irreversible Pulpitis for Diagnostic Biomarkers
pmc-13231072.creator: Raksha Bhat, Sean Prinson D’souza, Preethesh Shetty, Shruthi Padavu, Praveen Rai, Ballamoole Krishna Kumar, Shishir Shetty
pmc-13231072.description: Introduction and AimsThe diagnosis of pulpal inflammatory conditions poses significant challenges in clinical endodontics, requiring precise differentiation between reversible and irreversible states. This study investigated the differential expression patterns of 10 inflammatory genes: LCP2, PTPRC, CXCL8, TNFα, IL6, CCL2, MMP9, NOD2, ICAM1, and TLR8 in irreversible pulpitis as potential molecular diagnostic biomarkers.

pmc-13380664.title: Clinical Use of N-terminal Pro-B-Type Natriuretic Peptide (NT-proBNP) in Diagnosing Acute Heart Failure in Emergency Settings: A Systematic Review

pmc-13421897.title: Multimodality imaging in the diagnosis of biliary rhabdomyosarcoma in a young child: a case report
pmc-13421897.creator: Tianjiao Huang, Peng Wang, Danqing Huang, Jun Chen, Wentao Kong, Lichun Hua
pmc-13421897.description: BackgroundRhabdomyosarcoma (RMS) is the most common soft tissue sarcoma in children, but biliary involvement is extremely rare, accounting for approximately 0.5% of all pediatric RMS cases.Case presentationWe report a 2-year-11-month-old girl presenting with obstructive jaundice, whose condition was initially misdiagnosed as choledochal cysts.

pmc-13605466.title: Soft Skills in the Training of Future Dentists: Perceptions and Perspectives of Final-Year Students
pmc-13605466.creator: Cristina Gena Dascalu, Magda-Ecaterina Antohe, Diana Tatarciuc, Roxana Ionela Vasluianu, Cristina Iordache, Anca Vitalariu, Odette Elena Luca, Georgeta Liliana Foia
pmc-13605466.description: The practice of contemporary dentistry requires not only technical skills but also the development of soft skills, such as communication, empathy, and ethical and professional values. Although the importance of these skills is increasingly recognized, the perceptions of dental students in Romania regarding their relevance to their future professional practice remain insufficiently explored.

uslaw-usc-t16-s712.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s712.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 7 (Protection Of Migratory Game And Insectivorous Birds); Subchapter II (Migratory Bird Treaty). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (1) In accordance with the various migratory bird treaties and conventions with Canada, Japan, Mexico, and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, the Secretary of the Interior is authorized to issue such regulations as may be necessary.

uslaw-usc-t30-s576.title: 30 U.S.C. § 576 — Authorization of appropriations
uslaw-usc-t30-s576.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t30-s576.description: United States Code, Title 30 (Mineral Lands And Mining); Chapter 14 (Anthracite Mine Drainage And Flood Control). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. There is hereby authorized to be appropriated such amounts as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter.

uslaw-usc-t48-s1693.title: 48 U.S.C. § 1693 — Audit of government; access to books, records, etc.
uslaw-usc-t48-s1693.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t48-s1693.description: United States Code, Title 48 (Territories And Insular Possessions); Chapter 14 (Trust Territory Of The Pacific Islands). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Comptroller General of the United States, or any of his duly authorized representatives, shall have access, for the purpose of audit and examination, to any relevant books, documents, papers, or records of the government of the Trust Territory of.
